memory.reason: Routed fixture retains the existing BRAM bank and adds one host page for a 2 KiB matrix.

memory_bandwidth.reason: Accepted counts and derived interface bytes. DDR controller traffic was not measured.

model_quality.reason: Frozen arithmetic, weights and exact outputs.

operating_conditions.reason: Board clock framework reports 50 MHz. Thermal snapshots are retained with the arm evidence.

physical_area.reason: Outside the fixed single-board circuit-comparison scope.

power_validation.reason: INA260 module measurement without independent calibration.

prefill.reason: TTFT and DDR wait placement measured without a separate prefill timer.

resources.reason: Both modes share this routed dual-storage fixture.

serving_load.reason: Outside the fixed single-board circuit-comparison scope.

startup.reason: Separate matrix setup only. Cold startup was outside the timed comparison.

sustained_throughput.reason: Six-request window is a bounded mixed block.

workload_coverage.reason: Same three fixed prompts, exact outputs, and block ordering as Experiment 13.

correctness.evidence: Both smoke arms and all 18 warm-ups and 36 timed replies passed. Exact output bytes, stop reasons, context and projection counters were independently checked in the recovered logs.

limitations: Single KV260 and boot, fixed three-prompt workload with one request at a time.
Power covers gross VCC_SOM only. Mixed blocks include context clear, request gaps and result verification.
Off-module rail power and independent sensor calibration were not measured.
AXI beat counts measure bytes returned at the PL/PS interface. Actual DDR controller traffic is unavailable.
Both memory paths remain routed. Resource counts give the fixture cost.
The measured boot retained the expected unsigned out-of-tree module taint from the first attempt.

protocol.measurement_boundary: Board CPU admission to useful byte and completion observations, and gross VCC_SOM over each verified six-reply block. Matrix setup and warm-ups outside timed blocks.
protocol.quality_gate: Exact compact reference completions and causally reconciled weight-read counters.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Three exact requests per arm with loaded weights.

quality.evidence: Exact results for the frozen three-prompt workload and unchanged arithmetic.
